rav.text: Ravnica begins with ten factions signing the Guildpact to end centuries of war, and the paruns, Szadek among them, pooled their magic at the signing to make a treaty that enforced itself.
Peace did not mean calm: the Golgari Swarm fought over its leadership as Savra, helped by Szadek, took the guild from the Sisters of Stone Death, and Szadek later double-crossed her.
Agrus Kos arrested Szadek and, through a loophole, broke the Guildpact's spell, and Prahv, seat of Azorius power, was destroyed when the Parhelion collided with it.

gpt.text: In Guildpact, Ravnica's guilds turn on one another: the Gruul ravage the streets while Teysa leads the Orzhov Syndicate to cleanse them.
Borborygmos orders his horde to "Crush them!", and the nephilim awaken one after another, shaking the plane.
Beneath the violence, Szadek says none can oppose one who cannot be found, while Ilromov warns that guild fealty will bring the old gods back.

dis.text: By Dissension, guilds fight each other and monsters ravage Ravnica, and the chaos turns out to have been calculated.
Kos publicly arrests Szadek, finally breaking the Guildpact's spell and exposing House Dimir, while the Parhelion reappears on a collision course with Prahv.
Izolda rouses Rakdos with dragon spinal fluid and the blood of Jarad and Myc, and he wreaks havoc until Project Kraj absorbs him, after which her followers devour her alive.
In the aftermath a new Guildpact is created, the Schism fades and the district of Agyrem overlays Ravnica, with Feather leading the Boros and Jarad returning as a lich to lead the Golgari.

m12.text: Ravnica's part in Magic 2012 is small: after turning against and defeating Tezzeret, Jace becomes the de facto leader of the Consortium's Ravnica cell and puts its resources to work.

rtr.text: In Return to Ravnica the Guildpact is broken, leaving the guilds unbound and struggling for control of the plane, and Isperia is convinced to lead the Azorius as crime and chaos grow.
After Razia's death the Boros work as hired guards under Feather, and discontented members gather around the war-leader Aurelia, while Sinkholes let merfolk resurface to join the Simic Combine.
Jace marches into the depths of Ravnica in search of powerful magic, and at the Forum of Azor his telepathy stops the Maze, triggering the Supreme Verdict that makes him the Living Guildpact.

gtc.text: In Gatecrash the Ravnican guilds jockey for power: the Boros build a prison in the sky out of the reach of Azorius statutes, and Aurelia tells Gideon Jura he must first fight among the rank and file.
Aurelia denounces Niv-Mizzet, ending the Boros and Izzet collaboration on the Warmind Initiative, while the Rakdos unleash hellraiser goblins against Boros interference.
Jace begins to piece together the mystery of the Implicit Maze, setting off a race to unlock its secrets, and Teysa's coup against the Obzedat is foiled by her ghostly grandfather.

dgm.text: In Dragon's Maze, the Guildpact is destroyed and the Implicit Maze manifests across Ravnica, and Niv-Mizzet announces that each guild will send one champion to run it.
Ral Zarek discovers the maze on Niv-Mizzet's instruction using Jace's notes, and Mirko Vosk hunts anyone with knowledge of the maze, draining the other guilds' chances.
Emmara Tandris is chosen as Selesnya's champion, and Gideon Jura challenges Aurelia, saying "Scores will die in the name of peace."

ori.text: In Magic Origins, Ravnica is where Jace's past catches up with him: he destroys a sphinx's mind in a telepathic duel and accidentally planeswalks to the plane.
Liliana has Jace's friends assassinated, and he breaks into the Ravnica headquarters and wipes out the Consortium's Ravnican heads, later greeting her at his secret door with an illusion.
Meanwhile a goblin gang war burns Foundry Street, and Gideon captures Krenko and storms the Shattergang hideout, where he fights Rikkig and survives his bomb.

grn.text: In Guilds of Ravnica, Isperia gathers the guilds in a climate of suspicion to propose cooperation, while Niv-Mizzet disappears and Ral finds himself leading the Izzet.
Ral's storm detects planeswalkers infiltrating Ravnica, and with Vraska's rise the Erstwhile become an army for her and the kraul valued forces of the Swarm.
Vraska petrifies Isperia, fulfilling Bolas's demands and her own revenge, and the guilds' cooperation collapses, while Dovin Baan sabotages Ral's device, leaving Jace as the Living Guildpact.

rna.text: In Ravnica Allegiance, darkness comes to Ravnica as the guilds' peace nears breaking point and the Chamber of the Guildpact falls silent, its promise broken.
Domri defeats Borborygmos with Bolas's help and becomes Gruul guildmaster, and Kaya takes control of the Orzhov at Bolas's behest, while Dovin Baan takes over the Azorius Senate from within.
At the guild summit Emmara, Kaya and Teysa witness its dissolution after Isperia's murder, and Ral Zarek activates the Interplanar Beacon as Nicol Bolas arrives on the plane.

war.text: In War of the Spark, the Planar Bridge opens over the Chamber of the Guildpact and reduces it to rubble, and Ravnica becomes the battlefield where Bolas's Dreadhorde fights the guilds and planeswalkers.
The Elderspell drops Ravnica into artificial night as hundreds of planeswalkers are killed and their sparks harvested, making Bolas nearly invulnerable.
Liliana betrays Bolas and Niv-Mizzet impales him while Bontu bites him and explodes, dispersing the stolen sparks, and Gideon sacrifices himself to save Liliana.
Bolas is imprisoned, left to contemplate defeat for eternity.

jmp.text: In Jumpstart, Ravnica's defenders watch in horror as Oketra's shot pierces Gideon's pegasus and he falls holding the Blackblade.

h1r.text: In this set Ravnica is simply home: Sylvene returns there with her infant son and never comes back.

j22.text: In Jumpstart 2022 Ravnica is where Ob Nixilis is trapped, and with no affection for either side he commits random acts of torment.

mom.text: In March of the Machine, the compleated Vraska leads the Phyrexian invasion of Ravnica, riding a Realmbreaker branch down to plunge through the Azorius Senate and ordering her forces to blind the populace.
The Golgari fall to Phyresis faster than any other guild and swarm up from the Undercity, while Numerous Izzet willingly undergo compleation out of curiosity.

Jace organizes Ravnica's defense and the Boros fight on the frontline and suffer heavy losses, and Ral Zarek defeats Vraska with a sonic weapon, freeing her of Phyrexian control through Jace's memory reset.
Afterward the Orzhov profit from the disorder with loans at exorbitant interest.

mkm.text: In Murders at Karlov Manor, Zegana is assassinated at the manor and Etrata is arrested as a suspect, and Teysa Karlov is killed three days later, putting the city on the verge of chaos.
Alquist Proft helps Etrata escape Azorius custody to assist the investigation, while Aurelia drags in Massacre Girl and declares the Cult of Rakdos behind the killings.
Proft concludes that people are being brainwashed into attacks, and in the end Oba reveals she was behind the murders and attacks the guild leaders, but Kaya and Etrata defeat her.

clu.text: In Ravnica: Clue Edition, the Orzhov grow wealthier from exorbitant interest on wartime loans, only growing hungrier for more.

j25.text: In Foundations Jumpstart, Ravnica watches as Gideon flies to strike a god with his dark sword.
